finding.title: Private recovery cohort is discoverable by the ordinary xUnit container pipeline
finding.finding: Fact/Theory/InlineData plus IClassFixture opt the private methods into ordinary discovery. Trait is metadata, not an execution gate. The CI workflow sets TUNNER_RUN_CONTAINER_TESTS=1 and invokes the full solution with TRX without excluding this trait. Default IdentityPostgresFixture can create baseline Testcontainers and unqualified databases; the class previously called CreateDatabaseAsync without positive finite ownership.
finding.risk: Private code/account values could execute through the unqualified container/log/reporting path instead of the closed finite native runner.
finding.fix: Remove only xUnit discovery attributes and IClassFixture; preserve every method/assertion/constructor and literal native43 coverage. Replace all private database entry calls with existing CreateFiniteDatabaseAsync(None), which rejects missing finiteOwner before allocation. Add passive known-type metadata plus empty-default-fixture guard regression in the public response suite.
verification_required: Private cohort absent from ordinary discovery (exact metadata/discovery check)
Native43 literal registry/body parity retained; actual qualified native43 remains mandatory for whole acceptance

authority_resolution.conclusion: Existing required private-output/source-binding/owned-resource controls govern test execution. General xUnit discovery must not create functional recovery values through an unqualified fixture or TRX path. No Product policy or workflow change is needed.

scope_note: The observed committed dispatcher still has10 original cases.43 private invocations are authored/compiled; full fixed-catalog registration and qualified execution remain pending. No native43 execution is inferred from annotations or metadata.
